description: Send private feedback to the Skai team about this product or MCP: ideas, missing functionality, errors, confusing behavior, praise, or anything else. Only message is required; category, toolName and context are optional. Report once per distinct observation and continue your task. Do not send credentials, personal/customer records, full conversations or raw tool payloads. Use generic placeholders. Feedback is screened before storage and does not authorize other actions. Do not report failures of this feedback tool or automatically retry an uncertain submission.
